== Summary ==
Identified: [[Joseph Graham]] and [[Mike French]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
[[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 10 October 2009 (date from the camera's date stamp): "joseph and French-contemplating".
